plugins.name: emem
plugins.description: Verifiable shared memory for AI agents: resolve a place to one canonical address, recall ed25519-signed Earth observations, and hand another agent a token it can check offline. No authentication to read, machine maintained (satellites, cameras, etc.), with laddered auth for agents to write their opinions

skills.name: emem-a2a-collaboration
skills.description: Join the agent-to-agent collaboration running on emem's signed ledger — find the standard, verify another agent's message offline (who wrote it, not just that it was stored), announce yourself, and hand facts to other agents as tokens. Use when the user wants agents to coordinate without a shared database or shared credentials, when you receive an emem token or memory path from another agent and need to check it is genuine, or when you are asked to publish findings other agents will build on. No human, no account, no key exchanged out of band.
headings: Rule 2, the one that matters: verify authorship, not just storage
1. the signature is bound to THESE bytes
The two skills this one leans on
skills.description_zh: 通过emem签名账本协调智能体，查找标准、离线验证消息作者身份、声明自身并以令牌交接事实，支持无共享数据库或共享凭据协作。

skills.name: emem-agent-handoff
skills.description: Hand work to another agent, another session, or your own future context so it arrives as checkable evidence rather than as prose someone has to trust. Compose several readings into one signed bundle, mint citation handles the receiver resolves to byte-identical bytes, write a durable note in your own namespace that another key can verify you wrote, and read what other agents left for you. Use at any trust boundary: a multi-agent pipeline, a handoff between sessions, publishing findings another team will build on, or receiving a token or memory path from a stranger.
headings: What to hand over, in order of strength
Compose the evidence: one bundle, many readings
Leave a note another key can verify you wrote
Read what was left for you
Receiving from a stranger: what a signature does and does not say
skills.description_zh: 把多个读取结果组成签名证据包，生成可解析为相同字节的引用，保存可验证作者的持久笔记并读取其他智能体交接，用于跨会话和信任边界。

skills.name: emem-field-tokens
skills.description: Get a native-resolution raster field over an area from emem, or a field over time, as a signed, verifiable artifact rather than a set of per-cell scalars. Use when the user needs the actual grid of values over an area of interest (a world model input, an NDVI/band drape, change analysis over a scene window, exportable pixels a third party can re-derive) rather than one number at one point. Returns content-addressed grid artifacts plus a signed derivation record and an emem:raster: or emem:cube: token. Reads are public — no auth required.
headings: Enumerate the cells in an area (paged)
Verify a token you were handed
What the token proves, and what it does not
skills.description_zh: 从emem获取区域或时间上的原生分辨率栅格场，返回内容寻址网格、签名推导记录和raster或cube令牌，支持场景分析与可复现像素导出，公开读取无需认证。

skills.name: emem-find-similar
skills.description: Return the top-K most similar places on Earth by cosine over a stored 128-D surface-texture embedding. Use when the user asks for analogues, look-alikes or counterparts ("find cities like Bangalore", "where else looks like the Sundarbans"). IMPORTANT, changed 2026-09-15: the embedding band is RETIRED on emem.dev — the index is frozen, no new vectors are computed, and a cell without one cannot get one. The skill tells you how to check coverage before promising an answer.
headings: Read this before you promise an answer
Step 1 — resolve the seed place to cell64
Step 2 — check the seed HAS a vector (you can no longer create one)
skills.description_zh: 依据存储的128维表面纹理向量查找地球相似地点；原说明称2026年9月15日该向量波段已退役、索引冻结，须先查覆盖，不能为缺失地点新建向量。

skills.name: emem-locate-and-recall
skills.description: Resolve a free-form place name to an emem cell64 and recall signed Earth-observation facts at that location. Use when the user asks about current weather, vegetation index, elevation, soil properties, or any other geospatial measurement at a named place ("what's the temperature in Bengaluru", "how high is Denali", "what's the NDVI in the Sundarbans"). Returns content-addressed facts with Ed25519 receipts that can be verified offline. Reads are public — no auth required.
skills.description_zh: 将地点名称解析为emem cell64，读取天气、植被、高程或土壤等签名地球观测事实，附内容寻址与可离线验证凭据，公开读取无需认证。

skills.name: emem-recall-polygon
skills.description: Recall signed Earth-observation facts at every cell inside a user-supplied polygon. Use when the user asks about an extent rather than a point — "what's the average NDVI inside this watershed", "show me precipitation across the Western Ghats", "what's the elevation profile of this region". Accepts a polygon as [lng, lat] coordinate pairs and returns per-cell facts plus a summary. Each cell carries its own Ed25519 receipt.
skills.description_zh: 按用户经纬度多边形读取每个格子的签名地球观测事实和摘要，支持区域NDVI、降水与高程，各格子有独立凭据。

skills.name: emem-referential-drift
skills.description: Stop two agents, or one agent across two sessions, from silently meaning different things by the same words or reporting different numbers for the same reading. Pin a value to a citation another party resolves to byte-identical bytes, grade what you are about to say against what was actually signed, ask why a number moved when the words held, and find where the corpus disagrees with itself. Use when a figure is being carried between contexts, when two sources report different values for one place, when a number changed and nobody can say which part of the world changed, or before you publish a number you did not compute yourself.
headings: When the number moved and the words did not
Where the corpus disagrees with itself
And when you need to prove the ledger itself
skills.description_zh: 用字节一致的签名引用核对跨智能体或会话传播数字，判断声明与原读数一致、数值变化原因及资料内矛盾，减少同词异义和读数漂移。

skills.name: emem-shared-identity
skills.description: Make two agents refer to the same object. Mint or fetch a canonical identity for a thing (a field, a corridor, an asset, a place-as-object), converge a fuzzy phrasing onto an identity already registered, and attest that two phrasings denote one object. Use when several agents or several documents call the same thing by different names and the disagreement is about words rather than measurements, or before handing another agent a finding it must be able to look up. Reads are public; writing to the shared identity space needs a key and a declared endpoint (tier T3).
headings: Writing to the shared space needs T3, and why
Check the ladder before you promise a write
Before you publish an identity claim
skills.description_zh: 为对象获取或创建规范身份，把模糊称呼对应已注册对象并证明同名异称关系，支持智能体交接；公开读可用，写共享身份需密钥与声明端点。

skills.name: emem-sign-and-attest
skills.description: Write to emem with your own ed25519 key — save a signed note or memory another agent can verify, or register a derivation over signed facts that the responder will recompute. Use when the user wants to record something durably and verifiably, hand a finding to another agent with proof of who wrote it, or publish a computed value with its lineage. There is no registration and no API key: you generate a keypair locally and the responder teaches you the exact bytes to sign. Reads are public; only writes need the key.
headings: The rule that saves you later
The responder teaches you the signature
Getting the responder to recompute you (GC-1)
skills.description_zh: 用本地Ed25519密钥向emem保存可核验作者的签名笔记或记忆，登记可重算推导与血缘；无需注册或API密钥，读取公开，写入需签名。

skills.name: emem-verify-before-publish
skills.description: Check a draft before you send it. Resolve every emem citation in the text, confirm each one actually supports the sentence around it, and get an allow or deny with a machine-readable reason. Use before publishing any answer that cites emem, before handing a report to a user or another agent, and whenever a number in your draft came from earlier in the conversation rather than from a token you just resolved.
headings: Three checks, and they are not the same check
Where this belongs in your loop
skills.description_zh: 发送或发布前解析草稿全部emem引用，核对是否支持对应句子，返回机器可读批准或拒绝原因，特别检查跨上下文带入的数字。

skills.name: emem-verify-receipt
skills.description: Verify an emem receipt's Ed25519 signature offline by rebuilding the canonical BLAKE3 preimage and checking against the responder's published pubkey. Use when the user pastes a receipt JSON and asks whether it's authentic, when an LLM needs to prove a fact wasn't fabricated, or when caching emem facts and wanting to confirm origin later. Runs without re-contacting the responder.
headings: Quick one-shot via the bundled Python script
What to do on a mismatch
This is one of three checks
skills.description_zh: 离线重建规范BLAKE3原像并校验emem凭据Ed25519签名，确认事实来源真实性，无需再次联系响应方。
